mapper.sql: FROM tb_inbound_correct c JOIN tb_inbound i ON i.inbound_seq = c.inbound_seq JOIN tb_warehouse w ON w.warehouse_seq = i.warehouse_seq JOIN tb_plant p ON p.plant_seq = w.plant_seq LEFT JOIN tb_code_group rg ON rg.code_group_id = 'REASON_CORRECT' LEFT JOIN tb_code rc ON rc.code_group_seq = rg.code_group_seq AND rc.code_id = c.reason_code LEFT JOIN tb_user ru ON ru.user_id = c.requested_by LEFT JOIN tb_user du ON du.user_id = c.decided_by

c.correct_seq, c.correct_no, c.inbound_seq, c.correct_status, c.reason_code, c.remark, c.requested_by, c.requested_at, c.decided_by, c.decided_at, c.decide_remark, c.created_by, c.created_at, c.updated_by, c.updated_at, i.inbound_no AS inbound_no, i.inbound_status AS inbound_status, w.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, p.plant_id AS plant_id, p.plant_name AS plant_name, p.org_seq AS org_seq, rc.code_name AS reason_name, ru.user_name AS requested_by_name, du.user_name AS decided_by_name,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_inbound_correct_line l WHERE l.correct_seq = c.correct_seq) AS line_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.qty_delta), 0) FROM tb_inbound_correct_line l WHERE l.correct_seq = c.correct_seq) AS total_delta

where.if: AND (c.correct_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR i.inbound_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR c.remark ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR rc.code_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')

mapper.sql: JOIN tb_inbound_putaway pw ON pw.putaway_seq = cl.putaway_seq JOIN tb_inbound_line il ON il.line_seq = pw.line_seq JOIN tb_inbound ib ON ib.inbound_seq = il.inbound_seq JOIN tb_location loc ON loc.location_seq = pw.location_seq JOIN tb_warehouse w ON w.warehouse_seq = loc.warehouse_seq JOIN tb_plant p ON p.plant_seq = w.plant_seq JOIN tb_sku k ON k.sku_seq = il.sku_seq JOIN tb_product pr ON pr.product_seq = k.product_seq LEFT JOIN tb_stock s ON s.location_seq = pw.location_seq AND s.sku_seq = il.sku_seq AND s.supplier_seq IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ib.supplier_seq

pw.putaway_seq AS putaway_seq, il.line_seq AS inbound_line_seq, pw.location_seq AS location_seq, loc.location_id AS location_id, w.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id, p.plant_id AS plant_id, k.sku_seq AS sku_seq, k.sku_id AS sku_id, pr.product_name AS product_name, k.color_code AS color_code, k.size_code AS size_code, pw.qty AS putaway_qty, s.qty_on_hand AS qty_on_hand

(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(x.qty_delta), 0) FROM tb_inbound_correct_line x JOIN tb_inbound_correct xc ON xc.correct_seq = x.correct_seq WHERE x.putaway_seq = pw.putaway_seq AND xc.correct_status = 'APPROVED'
mapper.select:
SELECT cl.line_seq, cl.correct_seq, cl.line_no, cl.qty_delta, cl.reason_code, cl.remark, cl.applied_history_seq, rc.code_name AS reason_name, ,
AND x.correct_seq <> cl.correct_seq) AS corrected_qty FROM tb_inbound_correct_line cl
LEFT JOIN tb_code_group rg ON rg.code_group_id = 'REASON_CORRECT' LEFT JOIN tb_code rc ON rc.code_group_seq = rg.code_group_seq AND rc.code_id = cl.reason_code WHERE cl.correct_seq = #{correctSeq} ORDER BY cl.line_no

SELECT NULL::bigint AS line_seq, NULL::bigint AS correct_seq, NULL::integer AS line_no, NULL::integer AS qty_delta, NULL::varchar AS reason_code, NULL::varchar AS remark, NULL::bigint AS applied_history_seq, NULL::varchar AS reason_name, ,
) AS corrected_qty FROM tb_inbound_putaway pw JOIN tb_inbound_line il ON il.line_seq = pw.line_seq JOIN tb_inbound ib ON ib.inbound_seq = il.inbound_seq JOIN tb_location loc ON loc.location_seq = pw.location_seq JOIN tb_warehouse w ON w.warehouse_seq = loc.warehouse_seq JOIN tb_plant p ON p.plant_seq = w.plant_seq JOIN tb_sku k ON k.sku_seq = il.sku_seq JOIN tb_product pr ON pr.product_seq = k.product_seq LEFT JOIN tb_stock s ON s.location_seq = pw.location_seq AND s.sku_seq = il.sku_seq AND s.supplier_seq IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ib.supplier_seq WHERE il.inbound_seq = #{inboundSeq} ORDER BY il.line_no, pw.putaway_seq
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_inbound_correct (correct_no, inbound_seq, correct_status, reason_code, remark, requested_by, created_by) VALUES (#{correctNo}, #{inboundSeq}, #{correctStatus}, #{reasonCode}, #{remark}, #{requestedBy}, #{createdBy})
INSERT INTO tb_inbound_correct_line (correct_seq, line_no, putaway_seq, qty_delta, reason_code, remark) VALUES (#{correctSeq}, #{lineNo}, #{putawaySeq}, #{qtyDelta}, #{reasonCode}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_inbound_correct SET reason_code = #{reasonCode}, remark = #{remark}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE correct_seq = #{correctSeq}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_inbound_correct_line cl JOIN tb_inbound_correct c ON c.correct_seq = cl.correct_seq WHERE cl.putaway_seq = #{putawaySeq} AND c.correct_status = 'REQUESTED'
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_inbound_line SET received_qty = received_qty + #{qtyDelta}, putaway_qty = putaway_qty + #{qtyDelta}, updated_by = #{actor}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE line_seq = #{lineSeq}
